test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
In the following question, a sentence has been given in Indirect Speech. Choose the correct Direct Speech form.

The climatologist said that if global temperatures kept rising, sea levels would threaten major coastal cities.

options.text: The climatologist said, "If global temperatures kept rising, sea levels will threaten major coastal cities."
The climatologist said, "If global temperatures had kept rising, sea levels would have threatened major coastal cities."
The climatologist said, "If global temperatures kept rising, sea levels would threaten major coastal cities."
The climatologist said, "If global temperatures keep rising, sea levels threaten major coastal cities."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The climatologist said that if global temperatures kept rising, sea levels would threaten major coastal cities.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"if global temperatures kept rising, sea levels would threaten" becomes "If global temperatures kept rising, sea levels would threaten"**
 
 
• The conditional clause remains unchanged, as it is already in the correct tense for Direct Speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "The climatologist said that"
 
• Converted to: "The climatologist said," while maintaining proper punctuation.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "If" and ends with a period ".".
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The climatologist said, "If global temperatures kept rising, sea levels would threaten major coastal cities.""*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "If global temperatures kept rising, sea levels will threaten major coastal cities."

 
 
• Incorrect tense: "will threaten" is inconsistent with the past conditional "if global temperatures kept rising."
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "If global temperatures had kept rising, sea levels would have threatened major coastal cities."
 
 
• Incorrect: Changes the condition to past perfect, altering the meaning of the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "If global temperatures keep rising, sea levels threaten major coastal cities."
 
 
• Incorrect: Changes the tense to present, altering the original meaning of the conditional statement.
